# Archzona Structures - Comprehensive Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

## About Archzona Structures
Archzona Structures is an architectural experience centre and turnkey execution firm located in Dombivli East, Thane, Maharashtra (India). Archzona provides architects, interior designers, commercial developers, and luxury homeowners with high-performance building materials, outdoor architectural structures, and intelligent spatial infrastructure.

## Material Categories & Product Specifications
### 1. WPC (Wood Polymer Composite)
- Applications: Outdoor Decking, Pool Surrounds, Exterior Wall Fluted Cladding, Louvers, Soffits, Gates.
- Key Specs: Co-extruded 360° protective cap, 25+ years lifespan, non-splintering, zero painting/oiling required, termit-proof.

### 2. HPL (High-Pressure Laminate)
- Applications: Ventilated Rainscreen Facades, Villa Elevation Cladding, Balcony Dividers, Commercial Envelopes.
- Key Specs: Thermosetting resin matrix, Class B-s1 fire rating, EN 438 impact resistance, UV resistant acrylic coating.

### 3. ACP (Aluminium Composite Panels)
- Applications: Monolithic High-Rise Facades, Corporate Signage, Canopy Soffits, Demountable Partitions.
- Key Specs: Dual 0.5mm aluminium skins, Mineral core fire-retardant (FR grade), PVDF exterior finish.

### 4. Tensile Fabric Shade Membranes
- Applications: Car Parking Canopies, Resort Amphitheaters, Rooftop Lounges, Poolside Shade Sails.
- Key Specs: 900-1050 GSM PVDF coated polyester yarn / PTFE mesh, 95% UV blockage, 180 km/h wind rating.

### 5. Smart Parking Systems
- Applications: Residential Towers, Commercial Malls, Boutique Hotels, Corporate Headquarters.
- Offerings: 2 & 3 Level Hydraulic Stack Parking, Automated Matrix Multi-Tier Puzzle Parking, Integrated EV Fast Charging.
